info.title: SmartCity Backend API
info.description: REST API for managing public buildings and energy devices in a smart city

put.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
put.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building identified by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is being updated.

200.description: Energy consumption updated successfully for the specified building.

400.description: Invalid request payload — e.g. missing required fields, negative consumption value, or unsupported energy unit.

example.message: Validation failed: consumptionValue must be greater than or equal to 0

404.description: No public building found with the provided UUID.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' not found

post.description: Registers a new public building in the smart city system. Returns the unique identifier of the newly created building.

200.description: Public building successfully created. Returns the UUID of the new building.

400.description: Invalid request data. This may occur if required fields such as name or location are missing or malformed.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered public buildings, including their energy consumption details and associated energy devices.

200.description: List of public buildings successfully retrieved

post.summary: Add an energy device to a building
post.description: Registers a new energy device (e.g. solar panel, EV charger, smart meter) and associates it with the specified public building.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building to which the device will be added.

200.description: Energy device successfully added to the building. Returns the newly created device's UUID.

400.description: Invalid request payload — required fields are missing or contain malformed values (e.g. unknown device type or negative capacity).

example.message: Device type must not be null

404.description: No public building found with the provided identifier.

example.message: Public building with id 'b3f1c2d4-8e5a-4f7b-9c0d-1a2e3f456789' does not exist

409.description: A device with the same identifier or name already exists in this building, causing a conflict.

example.message: A device named 'Solar Panel A1' already exists in building 'b3f1c2d4-8e5a-4f7b-9c0d-1a2e3f456789'

patch.summary: Update production rate of a device
patch.description: Updates the energy production rate and unit for a specific energy device within a public building. Use this endpoint when a device's generation capacity changes (e.g., solar panel output adjustment).

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building that owns the device

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the energy device whose production rate is being updated

400.description: Invalid request payload — production value is missing, negative, or the unit is not a recognized energy unit

example.message: productionValue must be greater than or equal to 0

404.description: Building or device not found — no public building or energy device exists for the provided identifiers

example.message: Energy device with id '7cb94e21-1a3b-4d8e-9f02-abc123def456' not found in building '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6'

get.summary: Get a public building by ID
get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific public building, including its name, location, current energy consumption, and the list of associated energy devices.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the public building to retrieve.

200.description: Public building found and returned successfully.

404.description: No public building was found with the provided ID.

example.message: Public building with id '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered public buildings in the smart city, including their energy consumption details and associated devices.

200.description: A list of all public buildings was successfully retrieved.

ChangeConsumptionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy consumption value and unit of an asset.

consumptionValue.description: The new energy consumption value. Must be zero or positive.

consumptionUnit.description: The unit of energy consumption associated with the consumption value.

CreateBuildingRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new building asset in the smart city system.

name.description: The unique display name of the building.

location.description: The physical address or geographic location of the building.

AddDeviceRequest.description: Request payload for adding a new device to an asset in the smart city system.

type.description: The type of device being added. Determines how the device is categorized and managed within the asset.

ratedCapacityValue.description: The rated capacity value of the device. Must be a positive number representing the device's maximum operational capacity.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the rated capacity value. Defines the scale of the device's energy capacity.

ChangeProductionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy production value and unit of an asset

productionValue.description: The new energy production value for the asset. Must be zero or positive.

productionUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy production value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts)

EnergyDeviceResponse.description: Represents an energy device asset with its rated capacity and production rate specifications.

id.description: Unique identifier of the energy device.

type.description: The category of the energy device (e.g., solar panel, pump, or battery storage).

ratedCapacityValue.description: The maximum power capacity the device is rated to handle, expressed in the corresponding unit.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the rated capacity value.

productionRateValue.description: The current or nominal rate at which the device produces or consumes energy, expressed in the corresponding unit.

productionRateUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the production rate value.

PublicBuildingResponse.description: Represents a public building asset in the smart city, including its energy consumption details and associated energy devices.

id.description: Unique identifier of the public building.

location.description: Physical address or geographic location of the public building.

consumptionValue.description: Current energy consumption value of the building, expressed in the unit specified by consumptionUnit.

consumptionUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the energy consumption value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

devices.description: List of energy devices installed in the public building that contribute to its overall energy consumption.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned by the API when a request fails. Contains details about the error code, human-readable message, HTTP status, time of occurrence, and a unique request identifier for tracing.

errorCode.description: Application-specific error code identifying the type of error.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error providing context about what went wrong.
message.example: Asset with ID 42 was not found in the system.

status.description: HTTP status code associated with the error response.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the error occurred.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the request, useful for correlating logs and tracing the error across services.
